assessments.rationale: Five explicit components serve present transport, identity, reservation, persistence and presentation duties. Standard-library HTTP and SQLite avoid plugin abstractions and runtime dependencies for this bounded app.

Reservations owns the policy and ordered business decisions. Storage counts rows rather than maintaining duplicate seat counters. Frontend reads active_limit and active_count from the public contract.

SQL is restricted to Storage; credential/session registry is in Identity; transport derives the principal and calls Reservations. Actual AST scan and foreign-cancellation HTTP tests support these boundaries.

Independent agents implemented frontend and backend against frozen public HTTP/Python contracts. Actual combined tests demonstrate integration; component boundaries include short responsibility/rationale/exclusions.
